title: Kilagen program configuration
description: program/config.yml — who this program belongs to, how far its content has been migrated, and which frameworks it is measured against. Coverage is computed over those frameworks and nothing else.

name.description: The program's name, shown in the dashboard header.

repo.description: Where this repository lives, as 'owner/repo' or its github.com URL. Used to link a document back to its source; leave empty for none.

schema_version.description: How far the content has been migrated. Written by 'kilagen update content'; never edited by hand.

organization.description: Who the program belongs to. Rendered in the About view.

frameworks.description: The frameworks in scope. An id is enough — Kilagen ships the clause vocabularies.

id.description: Resolved against the shipped catalogue, then program/model/frameworks/.

binding.description: Who checks. mandatory: a law, a regulator or a contract requires it. voluntary: you audit yourself and assert conformity. reference: you use it as guidance and assert nothing.

stale_gap_days.description: How many days a gap may stay open before check calls it stale. The number is arbitrary but it has to be declared: past it, an open gap is either a remediation that stalled or an exception nobody filed, and the check exists to force that choice.
